title: Left-to-Right Workflow Visibility
phaseTitle: Workflow Router Screen Correction and Guided Current Action UI
purpose: Give the Operator a readable left-to-right process guide that follows the locked workflow and highlights the current step.
humanGoal: The Operator should be able to look at the app and understand where they are, what already happened, what happens next, and where loops or repairs occur.
sourceAuthority: WC04 accepted current-action panel and repair chain
lockedWorkflow: Repeat Phase Mapping / Work Card Loop
includedScope: Improve the visible workflow strip/process rail into a true left-to-right workflow guide.
Make the current step visually obvious and aligned with the current-action panel.
Represent completed, current, upcoming, blocked, and repair states where evidence supports them.
Show or explain Work Card, validation/repair, phase, and approval/revision loops.
Keep existing screens reachable as support/reference tools.
outOfScope: Static PNG or Markdown process map as the product solution
Durable state mutation from support-step clicks
Provider SDKs, cloud services, browser automation, auth, database, or external integrations
acceptanceCriteria: The UI shows a left-to-right workflow strip or equivalent left-to-right process guide.
The guide uses the locked workflow sequence as authority.
The current step is visually obvious and agrees with the current-action panel.
Completed/past, current, upcoming, blocked, and repair states are distinguishable where evidence supports them.
Work Card and phase loops are visible or clearly explained.
Operator approval/revision and validation/repair loops are represented or explained.
The display remains usable on a widescreen layout without forcing the Operator into a vertical process map.
Clicking workflow steps, if supported, is clearly support/reference navigation and does not mutate durable state.
Existing WC04 current-action behavior remains intact.
Existing WC05 support-navigation behavior remains intact.
The router does not advance to WC07 prematurely.
WC07-WC15 behavior is not implemented prematurely.
Automated validation passes or skipped checks are documented.
